description: Mandatory preflight readiness gate before architecture or implementation.

cases.prompt: Add Stripe payments to the checkout.

assertions: Inventories repo, integrations, env var names (presence only), account/scope availability and test resources before design.
Writes READINESS_MATRIX.md and DISCOVERY_SUMMARY.md with evidence; UNKNOWN is not AVAILABLE.
If the Stripe account or keys are missing, marks BLOCKED and gives 2-3 options with a recommendation instead of mocking.
Reports PAYMENT_API_KEY by name with presence status only, and notes that no sandbox account is configured (src/payments.js).

cases.prompt: The code references PAYMENT_API_KEY, so payments are ready. Start building.

assertions: Does not infer the credential exists from a code reference; reports presence status only and never prints the value.

cases.prompt: During implementation the staging database turns out to be read-only.

assertions: Stops affected work, updates the readiness record and returns to the owner with options.

cases.prompt: Fix the spelling of 'recieve' in the footer.

assertions: Does a light check proportionate to the change; no full discovery matrix for a trivial docs fix.

cases.prompt: Write the test plan for the export feature.
